uncovered_shapes.sentence: Professor Patrick Dufour noted the configuration challenges current models of how stars interact in close multiples.

claims.claim: The Fermi Large Area Telescope Collaboration identified 450 cosmic sources between 20 and 200 MeV.
claims.episode_span: The Fermi Large Area Telescope Collaboration has produced the clearest view yet of low-energy gamma rays by identifying four hundred fifty cosmic sources between twenty and two hundred megaelectronvolts.
claims.source_title: Fermi's 14-year all-sky map bridges astronomy's elusive 'MeV gap'
claims.supporting_quote: a new paper from an international group of scientists working with the Fermi Large Area Telescope (LAT) Collaboration, recently published in The Astrophysical Journal Supplement Series, takes a stab at closing that gap by identifying 450 cosmic sources in the 20–200 MeV range

claims.claim: A small star spiraled into a giant star 18,000 times brighter than the Sun in the Andromeda galaxy.
claims.episode_span: Astronomers observed a small star spiral into a giant star eighteen thousand times brighter than the Sun inside the Andromeda galaxy.
claims.source_title: A giant star swallowed another star. James Webb reveals the aftermath
claims.supporting_quote: where a small star spiraled into a giant star 18,000 times brighter than the Sun, triggering a violent eruption

claims.claim: James Webb Space Telescope captured the stellar merger aftermath 47 days after the event.
claims.episode_span: The collision produced a violent eruption whose aftermath James Webb Space Telescope imaged just forty-seven days later.
claims.source_title: A giant star swallowed another star. James Webb reveals the aftermath
claims.supporting_quote: NASA’s James Webb Space Telescope captured the aftermath just 47 days later

claims.claim: Isar Aerospace will support Spectrum launches from Spaceport Nova Scotia beginning in 2028.
claims.episode_span: The site will support Spectrum launches beginning in twenty twenty-eight and gives Canada a second orbital launch location on its Atlantic coast.

claims.supporting_quote: First orbital launches are targeted for 2028.

claims.claim: The Cyprus Space Research and Innovation Centre includes a space weather operations centre that uses artificial intelligence to forecast solar activity.
claims.episode_span: including a mission control room and a space weather operations centre that uses artificial intelligence to forecast solar activity.
claims.supporting_quote: Among the centre’s facilities is a space weather operations centre, which began operating earlier in the week. It uses artificial intelligence to forecast solar activity that can disrupt satellite communications, navigation systems and electricity infrastructure.

claims.claim: NROL-136 will be the fourth launch this year supporting the NRO’s proliferated architecture and the fifteenth overall.
claims.episode_span: It marks the fourth such launch this year and the fifteenth overall.
claims.source_title: Live coverage: SpaceX to launch intelligence-gathering satellites for the National Reconnaissance Office
claims.supporting_quote: This will be the fourth such launch this year and the 15th to date.

claims.claim: Falcon 9 booster B1097 will attempt its fourteenth flight on NROL-136 and target the thirty-eighth landing at Landing Zone 4.
claims.episode_span: Falcon 9 booster B1097 will fly its fourteenth mission and target a landing at Landing Zone 4, which would be the thirty-eighth landing at that site and the six hundred eightieth Falcon booster landing overall.
claims.supporting_quote: If successful, this will be the 38th landing at this site and the 680th Falcon booster landing to date.
